correctness.rationale: With strictly positive normal gaps below π, successive tangent lines are active polygon sides. The exact link-length objective is a positively weighted tan-sum. Strict tan convexity makes the unique interior weighted-Lagrange stationary point global. The scalar root is unique by monotonicity. Splitting an interior half-angle strictly decreases length. Taylor expansion from the exact root gives π+2+π³/(12(k−1)²)+O((k−1)^−4). Independent geometric tangent-line construction in verify.py reproduces lengths, first-order conditions and low-link radicals, while analytic proof (not finite numerics) handles all k.

value.rationale: The classic optimal connected disk barrier uses a semicircular arc and two tangent segments and is not a finite-link polygonal construction. The finite-link budget is an intrinsic discretization parameter. Finding the unique polygon with two endpoint and one interior turning angles and the sharp explicit π³/(12(k−1)²) convergence quantifies unavoidable discretization penalty inside an opaque-barrier family. This is an exact, geometrically motivated classification for every k, not an arbitrary small numeric table or a routine isolated value.
